shared_elements: large frontal mask/head with prominent eyes
row of rectangular teeth or fangs
incised linear detailing around the face
justification: Both surfaces present a boldly schematic mask-like face in which the most legible feature is a row of blocky rectangular teeth flanked by heavy incised lines, and both reduce eyes and brows to simple grooved shapes rather than modelled naturalistic forms. However, A is a three-dimensional stacked composition of a fanged creature head set directly above a complete human face and torso, while B is a single low-relief head-and-band composition spread horizontally with adjacent panel-like motifs and no stacking or body, so the relationships and layout correspond only loosely.
